common_axiom_set_changes.explanation: Generated enc_length proof: old unrestricted simp and implicit coin-tape reductions were replaced by public coinLen/coins/eval readers, explicit Fin transport, List.ofFn_congr and simp only. The construction data fields are byte-identical. The reported proof axiom set loses Classical.choice; no new hypothesis or admission is introduced. Exact primitive dependency elimination is observed from the census, not reconstructed as a kernel proof-term trace.

The private structural fuel decoder is replaced by delegation to BinArith.decWords, whose home is Words.lean:97-100 and uses well-founded length recursion. The public equation covers empty, nonempty and malformed words. The delegated value now reports propext and Quot.sound, with no Classical.choice or sorryAx. The well-founded implementation is the source explanation; the exact primitive origin was not independently re-elaborated.

The statement is byte-identical before :=. Its proof now identifies Strategy.encodeMsgs with BinArith.encWords by List.rec and public nil/cons equations, then invokes BinArith.decWords_encWords. It retires the private fuel/length proof chain and loses Classical.choice while retaining propext and Quot.sound.

The statement is byte-identical before :=. Old proof was rfl for the fuel decoder; current proof is BinArith.decWords_nil. The imported well-founded decoder equation has propext and Quot.sound, so this wrapper acquires those standard axioms, with no Classical.choice or sorryAx.
